text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 26 और 27 पर ‘The Crowded Train’ पढ़ो। फिर सही विकल्प चुनो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 26 aur 27 par ‘The Crowded Train’ padho. Phir sahi vikalp chuno.
text.en: Read ‘The Crowded Train’ on pages 26 and 27 of your book. Then choose the right option.

steps.question: Where did Vinod go?
steps.modelAnswer: Vinod went to Bhopal on an official visit.

modelMeaning.hi: विनोद दफ़्तर के काम से भोपाल गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Vinod daftar ke kaam se Bhopal gaya.

steps.question: Why did Vinod decide to travel by A/C class?

questionMeaning.hi: विनोद ने एसी क्लास में जाने का फ़ैसला क्यों किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Vinod ne AC class mein jaane ka faisla kyon kiya?

options: He had a lot of money.
steps.modelAnswer: Vinod decided to travel by A/C class because the train was overcrowded.

modelMeaning.hi: विनोद ने एसी में जाने का फ़ैसला किया क्योंकि ट्रेन में बहुत भीड़ थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Vinod ne AC mein jaane ka faisla kiya kyonki train mein bahut bheed thi.

steps.question: The other passengers in the coach ...
options: did not look to be rich

steps.question: The young man who got in just when the train moved ...

questionMeaning.hi: जो नौजवान ट्रेन चलते ही चढ़ा, वह ...
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jo naujawaan train chalte hi chadha, woh ...

options: did not seem to have a job
steps.answer: did not seem to have a job

steps.question: Who did not have a valid ticket?

questionMeaning.hi: किसके पास सही टिकट नहीं था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kiske paas sahi ticket nahi tha?

steps.modelAnswer: Vinod did not have a valid ticket for the A/C coach, so he paid the difference. The young man had a valid ticket.

modelMeaning.hi: विनोद के पास एसी का सही टिकट नहीं था, इसलिए उसने बाकी पैसे दिए। नौजवान के पास सही टिकट था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Vinod ke paas AC ka sahi ticket nahi tha, isliye usne baaki paise diye. Naujawaan ke paas sahi ticket tha.

text.hi: अब किताब का दूसरा सवाल: घटनाओं को सही क्रम में लगाओ। सोचो, पहले क्या हुआ, फिर क्या।
text.hinglish: Ab kitaab ka doosra sawaal: ghatnaaon ko sahi kram mein lagao. Socho, pehle kya hua, phir kya.
text.en: Now the book's second task: put the events in order. Think: what happened first, then what?

steps.question: Which of these happened first?

questionMeaning.hi: इनमें से सबसे पहले क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Inmein se sabse pehle kya hua?

options: Vinod wanted to go back to Indore.
steps.answer: Vinod wanted to go back to Indore.

steps.question: What happened after Vinod saw the large crowd on the platform?

questionMeaning.hi: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर भीड़ देखने के बाद क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Platform par bheed dekhne ke baad kya hua?

options: He noticed some seats were vacant in the A/C coach.
steps.answer: He noticed some seats were vacant in the A/C coach.

steps.question: What happened just after the poorly-dressed young man jumped in?

questionMeaning.hi: फटे कपड़ों वाले नौजवान के चढ़ने के ठीक बाद क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Phate kapdon waale naujawaan ke chadhne ke theek baad kya hua?

options: All the passengers were surprised to see such a man in the A/C coach.
Vinod wanted to go back to Indore.
He noticed some seats were vacant.
steps.answer: All the passengers were surprised to see such a man in the A/C coach.

steps.question: What happened just before Vinod paid the difference?

questionMeaning.hi: विनोद के पैसे देने से ठीक पहले क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Vinod ke paise dene se theek pehle kya hua?

options: Vinod wanted to go back to Indore.
He saw a large crowd on the platform.

text.hi: सही क्रम: 3. Vinod wanted to go back to Indore. 6. He was surprised to see an unusually large crowd on the platform. 5. He noticed some seats were vacant in the A/C coach. 7. A poorly-dressed young man jumped into the coach. 4. All the passengers were surprised to see such a man. 2. The T.T.E. appeared. 1. Vinod paid the difference.
